claim: The Transit Gateway document history lists Transit gateway policy tables on July 13, 2022, described as policy tables that set up dynamic routing for transit gateways, automatically exchanging routing and reachability information with peered transit gateway types.
question: What did the July 13, 2022 Transit gateway policy tables history row describe?
note: The 2022 row describes policy tables for dynamic routing with peered transit gateways; the 2026 Policy-Based Routing row describes policy tables that forward traffic by packet attributes. Not examinable yet for the 2026 feature (GA after 2026-07-15).
